subproblem.title: A smooth (n−1)-form on ℝⁿ whose exterior derivative is a given partial derivative
subproblem.statement: Let m ∈ ℕ, a : ℝ^{m+1} → ℝ smooth (ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) a) and j ∈ Fin (m+1). Then there is a smooth m-form ψ on ℝ^{m+1} (IsSmoothForm ψ) with tsupport ψ ⊆ tsupport a such that dψ(x)(e₀, …, e_m) = ∂ⱼa(x) := Da(x)eⱼ for every x ∈ ℝ^{m+1}.
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (a : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ) (j : Fin (m + 1)), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) a → ∃ ψ : DifferentialForm (Euclid (m + 1)) m, IsSmoothForm ψ ∧ tsupport ψ ⊆ tsupport a ∧ ∀ x : Euclid (m + 1), exteriorDerivative ψ x (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) = fderiv ℝ a x (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: step 3 of the parent proof (ψ := a·βⱼ and dψ(x)(e₀, …, e_m) = ∂ⱼa(x)). Sibling lemmas used (as frozen declarations): Submission.dgcr_bwd_coordinate_covector and Submission.dgcr_bwd_extDeriv_smul_const.
Notation: ℝ^p means Euclid p = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p); e_l := EuclideanSpace.single l (1 : ℝ) is the l-th standard basis vector; for an (m+1)-tuple w, removeNth i w := Fin.removeNth i w is the m-tuple with entry i deleted, so (removeNth i w)(l) = w(i.succAbove l) (Fin.removeNth_apply); Covector E m = E [⋀^Fin m]→L[ℝ] ℝ (continuous alternating m-linear forms); DifferentialForm E m = E → Covector E m; exteriorDerivative = Mathlib's extDeriv (Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter06.exteriorDerivative is an abbrev), with the alternating-sum formula dω(x)(w₀,…,w_m) = Σᵢ (−1)^i • D[y ↦ ω(y)(removeNth i w)](x)(wᵢ) for ω differentiable at x (exteriorDerivative_apply); IsSmoothForm ψ := ContDiff ℝ ∞ ψ where ∞ = ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) (in the frozen contract scope `∞` denotes ENNReal's ∞ because of `open scoped ENNReal`, so write the order as (⊤ : ℕ∞)).
1. By the sibling Submission.dgcr_bwd_coordinate_covector applied to m and j, choose β ∈ Covector (Euclid (m+1)) m with β(removeNth i (l ↦ e_l)) = (if i = j then (−1)^j else 0) for every i ∈ Fin (m+1).
2. Put ψ(y) := a(y) • β. It is smooth: a is C^∞ and y ↦ β is constant, so their scalar product is C^∞ (ContDiff.smul with contDiff_const), i.e. IsSmoothForm ψ. Its support satisfies tsupport ψ ⊆ tsupport a (tsupport_smul_subset_left).
3. Fix x ∈ ℝ^{m+1}. Since a is C^∞ it is differentiable at x (ContDiff.differentiable with 1 ≤ ∞, then .differentiableAt). By the sibling Submission.dgcr_bwd_extDeriv_smul_const applied with P := m+1, the same m, a, β, x and w := (l ↦ e_l): dψ(x)(e₀, …, e_m) = Σᵢ (−1)^i · (Da(x)eᵢ · β(removeNth i e)).
4. By step 1 every term with i ≠ j vanishes (β(removeNth i e) = 0, so the term is (−1)^i·(Da(x)eᵢ·0) = 0), hence the sum equals its j-th term (Finset.sum_eq_single j; j ∈ Finset.univ): (−1)^j·(Da(x)eⱼ·(−1)^j) = ((−1)^j)^2·Da(x)eⱼ = ((−1)^2)^j·Da(x)eⱼ = Da(x)eⱼ = ∂ⱼa(x) (mul_assoc/mul_comm, pow_add, two_mul, pow_mul, then simp). As x was arbitrary, ψ has all required properties. ∎
Formalization note: this child is a machine leaf (one theorem `Submission.dgcr_bwd_coordinate_form` appended inside `namespace GMT.Ch07` of GMT/Ch07/Submission.lean; no helper declarations, no set_option). The following tactic proof was compiled on the pinned toolchain (Lean v4.35.0-rc3, Mathlib 25730c7c, simongmt 2b36630) in exactly that file context under default maxHeartbeats, passes the workflow's leaf source-delta check, and depends only on propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound (and the two sibling declarations named above); it may be used verbatim:
theorem Submission.dgcr_bwd_coordinate_form : ∀ (m : ℕ) (a : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ) (j : Fin (m + 1)), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) a → ∃ ψ : DifferentialForm (Euclid (m + 1)) m, IsSmoothForm ψ ∧ tsupport ψ ⊆ tsupport a ∧ ∀ x : Euclid (m + 1), exteriorDerivative ψ x (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) = fderiv ℝ a x (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)) := by
  intro m a j ha
  obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ := Submission.dgcr_bwd_coordinate_covector m j
  refine ⟨fun y => a y • β, ha.smul contDiff_const, tsupport_smul_subset_left _ _, fun x => ?_⟩
  have hax : DifferentiableAt ℝ a x := (ha.differentiable (by simp)).differentiableAt
  rw [Submission.dgcr_bwd_extDeriv_smul_const (m + 1) m a β x _ hax, Finset.sum_eq_single j]
  · rw [hβ j, if_pos rfl, ← mul_assoc, mul_comm ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (j : ℕ)), mul_assoc, ← pow_add,
      ← two_mul, pow_mul]
    simp
  · intro i _ hij
    rw [hβ i, if_neg hij]
    simp
  · intro hj
    exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ j) hj
proof_key_steps: ψ := a • β is smooth (ContDiff.smul) with tsupport ψ ⊆ tsupport a (tsupport_smul_subset_left).
Expand dψ(x)(e) by Submission.dgcr_bwd_extDeriv_smul_const as Σᵢ (−1)^i (∂ᵢa(x)·β(removeNth i e)).

audit.reason: The construction a • β establishes smoothness and the exact support inclusion. The two declared dependencies reduce the exterior-derivative sum to the j-th term, whose signs cancel. All hypotheses and conclusions match, without circular reliance.
